# MIQ Enterprises LLC

> MIQ Enterprises LLC is an international digital services and technology solutions company providing worldwide Wikipedia consulting and digital growth services for the United States and international clients.

## About
- Name: MIQ Enterprises LLC
- Website: https://miqenterprises.com

- Service area: United States and Worldwide

## Services
- Worldwide Wikipedia consulting: Wikipedia notability assessment, independent reliable source research, citation research, neutral drafting guidance, Wikipedia article writing guidance, Wikipedia editing support, Articles for Creation (AfC) process guidance, conflict-of-interest/paid-contribution disclosure guidance, and Wikipedia page maintenance recommendations for company, brand, and biography subjects. MIQ Enterprises LLC does not guarantee Wikipedia publication, approval, or retention.
- SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): technical SEO, content strategy, search intent, entity clarity, structured data guidance, and digital marketing.
- Website development: business websites, WordPress, e-commerce, landing pages, redesign, and maintenance.
- Online reputation management: ethical brand visibility and credibility strategy.
- Branding and creative solutions: identity, design, and marketing assets.
- Business and technology solutions: automation, AI integration guidance, lead generation, and digital consulting.
